title: After the Arima Kinen: Ramen to Wash Down the Loss

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser loses to Nice Nature in the Arima Kinen. After the race…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them go out for ramen. Matikanetannhauser reflects on the race and Nice Nature's noticeable improvement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Promising herself to do better next time, she slurps her noodles and prepares for the next race.
